proofs.text: Verify each fixture starts with files matching `*.proofs-*.json` and the verification file name; run the update with `--yes` and verify no such file is left on disk and none is tracked. Verify `.purlin/report-data.js` is tracked before and not after, is still on disk, and that `.gitignore` then names it and `.purlin/report-stamp.js`. Commit the cache directory the way a project would, verify `untracked-files` becomes pending, apply, and verify nothing under `.purlin/cache/` is tracked while the directory is still on disk

rule_text: No proof file and no verification file is left beside a spec, on disk or tracked; the dashboard data and the cache are untracked, left on disk, and named in `.gitignore`

tests.body:
def test_no_proof_or_verification_file_remains_on_disk(tmp_path, layout):
    root = _project(tmp_path, layout)
    assert _walk(root, LEFTOVER), 'the fixture should start with some'
    _apply(root)
    assert _walk(root, LEFTOVER) == []
